name: turn(box, 3 params)
script:
const t = box(30, 20, 10);
turn(t, [param('ax', 30), param('ay', 40), param('az', 50)]);

name: turn(cylinder, 3 params)
script:
const t = cylinder(10, 30);
turn(t, [param('ax', 30), param('ay', 40), param('az', 50)]);

name: turn(cone, 3 params)
script:
const t = cone(14, 18);
turn(t, [param('ax', 30), param('ay', 40), param('az', 50)]);

name: turn(ring, 3 params)
script:
const t = ring(30, 6);
turn(t, [param('ax', 30), param('ay', 40), param('az', 50)]);
dead: The slider "ax" does nothing: a ring has no turn slider yet -- the value 30 is used as typed; to change it, edit the number in the script.
The slider "ay" does nothing: a ring has no turn slider yet -- the value 40 is used as typed; to change it, edit the number in the script.
The slider "az" does nothing: a ring has no turn slider yet -- the value 50 is used as typed; to change it, edit the number in the script.

name: turn(sphere, 3 params)
script:
const t = sphere(14);
turn(t, [param('ax', 30), param('ay', 40), param('az', 50)]);
dead: The slider "ax" does nothing: a ball looks the same however it is turned, so turn() ignores it -- the value 30 is used as typed; to change it, edit the number in the script.
